source_axis_algorithm.marginal_filter: RNA positive count is from 4 through 508 in every source donor
source_axis_algorithm.ranking: descending minimum across source donors of min(RNA-positive cells, RNA-negative cells), then ascending protein name
source_axis_algorithm.selection: Traverse the ranking once. Accept a marker only if the complete cross-product of accepted markers plus the candidate has strictly positive pooled 2x2 cells in all eight sources, the four adult sources, and the four pediatric sources.
source_axis_algorithm.purpose: keep the standard global and age-stratified saturated Poisson interactions finite on exactly the primary coordinate axis

context_model.selection: leave-one-source-donor-out mean deviance; lexicographic parameter order breaks exact ties

classical_comparators.global: unregularized saturated Poisson interaction from the donor-pooled source 2x2 table
classical_comparators.age_stratified: the same interaction fitted separately to adult-pooled and pediatric-pooled source tables
classical_comparators.recipient_reconstruction: profile continuous recipient row and column parameters at the transported fixed interaction
classical_comparators.zero_cell_policy: unavailable; the source-axis algorithm removes such coordinates without a pseudocount

firewall.source_stage: may read source matrix/data, matrix/indices, matrix/indptr, ADT/data, ADT/indices, and ADT/indptr only after a public implementation tag and exclusive source claim
firewall.prediction_stage: may read held matrix/data, matrix/indices, and matrix/indptr for frozen RNA rows only; held ADT value and sparse-index datasets remain forbidden
firewall.score_stage: may read held RNA and ADT sparse values only after prediction publication and a separate public score authorization
